about.description: WTI crude oil perpetual market. The contract tracks West Texas Intermediate crude oil using a futures-based reference price with scheduled contract rolls. Users get linear oil price exposure only, without owning physical crude, inventory claims, or a deliverable futures position. Pricing follows the market reference used by the km venue on Hyperliquid. Positions are margined and cash-settled in USDH. Markets are visible on Hyperliquid under the km namespace, but are operated by Markets by Kinetiq rather than listed as core Hyperliquid perps.
